response.answer:
Yes. The **Bachelor of Accounting** is available to international applicants.

Key international-applicant information:

- A valid **BCIT study permit** is required before starting the program.
- The optional **Workplace Education Workterm 1 — FMGT 7610** and **Workplace Education Workterm 2 — FMGT 7620** are not available to international students.
- The program is delivered **in person** at the **Burnaby Campus** and offers full-time and part-time Flexible Learning options.
- The program information states that bachelor’s-degree graduates may apply for a **Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)**, but final eligibility and approval are determined by **IRCC** and require meeting all applicable IRCC requirements.

International applicants must also meet the program’s admission requirements, including a relevant diploma or equivalent, a minimum diploma GPA of 70%, English Studies 12 at 67% or equivalent, and other stated requirements. The subject-sequence and pre-entry-assessment requirements require institutional confirmation.

Program details: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/

For more information, see BCIT International Students: https://www.bcit.ca/international-students/.

program.program_overview: The Bachelor of Accounting program offers an academic credential leading to a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation. Choose between part-time Flexible Learning or full-time day stream options. Apply today to develop essential technical, communication, and problem-solving skills for success in the accounting field. Delivery: in person. See details . If you have completed a BCIT Accounting , Finance , or Financial Planning diploma, you can earn your Bachelor of Accounting (BAcc) at BCIT. This degree will provide you with an academic credential leading to a CPA (Chartered Professional Accountant ) designation, a MPAcc (Master of Professional Accounting) , or an MBA program. Students completing this program will acquire the key technical, interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills demanded by employers. The BCIT model: fast, flexible and effective BCIT’s Bachelor of Accounting is offered as: Flexible Learning: The flexible part-time program allows you to maintain your career and study at the same time. You can register course by course, and apply for admission to the program any time. Or Full-Time Day Stream: This program is offered on a full-time basis for those students who want to accelerate their completion of the program. The program starts every September and January. International study BCIT offers a number of international study opportunities that helps students gain a global perspective of the economy, culture, government, and everyday life of the country they study in. You could participate in a summer field school or complete an international degree. Learn more about studying abroad . Next up Entrance Requirements

For the **Bachelor of Accounting**, I can verify the following from the available program record:

### Verified program information

- It is an active **Bachelor’s Degree** program in the **School of Business + Media**.
- It is offered **in person at the Burnaby Campus**.
- It has **full-time** and **part-time Flexible Learning** options.
- It is available to **international applicants**.
- International students require a valid **BCIT study permit before starting**.
- The stated admission requirements include:
  - A BCIT Accounting, Finance, or Financial Planning diploma, or an equivalent external diploma assessed individually
  - A minimum diploma GPA of **70%**
  - **English Studies 12 at 67%**, or an equivalent
  - Five second-year subject-sequence averages normally at **65%**, with no more than two between **62% and 65%**
  - A signed departmental pre-entry assessment and any assigned bridging or upgrading
- The academic completion requirement is **60 credits**, including:
  - **FMGT 8911 — Strategic Performance Management**
  - Seven courses chosen from the approved Advanced Technical Specialty pool
  - **36.0 General Education credits**
- The optional work terms are:
  - **FMGT 7610 — Workplace Education Workterm 1**
  - **FMGT 7620 — Workplace Education Workterm 2**
  
  These are listed as available only to full-time domestic students and are unavailable to international students.
- The maximum completion time is stated as **seven years**.
- The program record states that bachelor’s-degree graduates may apply for a PGWP, but final eligibility and approval are determined by **IRCC**.
- The program is described as academic preparation aligned toward CPA pathways; it does **not itself award the CPA designation or professional licensure**.

### Confirm directly with BCIT

You should ask BCIT to confirm:

1. Whether your specific diploma is accepted as equivalent and whether bridging or upgrading will be assigned.
2. How your five subject-sequence averages will be assessed against the stated standard.
3. The exact process and outcome of the departmental pre-entry assessment.
4. Whether you have been **formally admitted**—international-applicant eligibility is not an admission decision.
5. The current international-student application, study-permit, tuition, and enrolment procedures.
6. Which General Education courses will satisfy the required categories, including the applicable **36-credit General Education policy**.
7. Your individual PGWP eligibility and immigration requirements with BCIT International and IRCC.
8. Whether any course availability or sequencing differs between the full-time and Flexible Learning options.

The verified program page is:  
https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/

The available data cannot verify your individual admission outcome, equivalency assessment, pre-entry assessment result, or final immigration eligibility.
